verdict.rationale: SES documents a sandbox where new users can test its capabilities. Sending is limited to verified identities, and all features stay usable, so testing cannot reach arbitrary real recipients. However, the sandbox is an initial account state rather than a separate, persistent test environment alongside production. It also sends real email to verified addresses, which is not an isolated dry-run. missing for 10: a documented separate test environment that persists after production access is granted, evidence that test data is isolated from production resources, any simulated or dry-run sending mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Amazon SES sandbox is an area where new users can test the capabilities of Amazon SES. When your account is in the sandbox, you can only send email to verified identities.
